name: seis-pazar-pay-intelligence
intent: Create a market-share connector lane for SEIS before using paid, account-scoped, or claim-sensitive market intelligence tools.
operating_mode: dry-run by default, connector activation only after metric scope is explicit

analysis_lanes.purpose: Estimate demand and search visibility through SEO and keyword signals.
Track brand mentions, sentiment, citation share, and narrative position.
Review product demand, assortment, pricing, and ecommerce category signals.
Compare account demand, channel performance, and GTM positioning.
Use public/private market, IR, KPI, and news context without making financial decisions.

metric_guardrails: Do not present connector output as exact market share unless the data source explicitly supports that metric.
Separate observed visibility, estimated traffic, conversation share, ecommerce demand, and financial context.
Record source, time window, geography, category definition, and confidence level for every market-share claim.
Use skipped_with_reason when an account-scoped connector is unavailable or unauthenticated.
Do not mutate CRM, ads, campaigns, or finance workflows from this lane.
blocked_by_default: public claim based on unverified metric
